findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Private data: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect · Public sink: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Private data: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect · Public sink: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
